a: The effect reads "Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon", so suspend 2 as possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I suspend only 1 of my opponent's Digimon, or none of their Digimon, if I use this card's effect while they have 2 or more Digimon that can be suspended?

Effect: [Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon with [Insect] in one of its traits. Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to the DP of the chosen Digimon. Then, 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon can't unsuspend during your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
